policy: User-provided atlas only. Merge only verified identical physical places (aliases preserved in sourceIds), not same-purpose rooms across sites. Multi-scope references reuse canonical IDs. AU generation locked except PC House London, CCC 07.18 main room and Liad's Attic. Presets are flexible illustrative corridor choices, never canon adjacency, and never generate outdoor yards/courtyards or Ministry when fixed templates exist.
